Annndddd here’s the method cus I hate to be annoying: 1. Azelaic acid + a retinoid 2. Barrier serum twice per day 3. Moisturiser AND sunscreen for max hydration 4. Skincare companies can release tonnes of new products that are all new and exciting. That doesn't mean our skin actually needs them. In fact, they rarely do.
